Kh.bar_b_note: Bright clean beach light is pleasant, but every frame is a wide gameplay camera with tiny speakers and a flat panel, with none of the framed two-shot staging or atmosphere a shipping game uses for dialogue.

Tv.bar_b_note: The violet-crystal wolf silhouette is close to the owner's Tanglevolt bar and towers over the ruler, but side B's faint poses flip to a white body with black blotches that breaks the creature's identity.

Yi.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder with a clear face, eyes and earthy green/brown kit sits comfortably at Palworld character finish, held back only by the plain dark stage and soft, slightly toy-like shading.

Ed.bar_b_note: The trainer is now clear, but Aquaryn has become a near-invisible ghost outline with a large hard shadow on bare, flat sand, so the subject and the beach both read unfinished.

Gz.bar_b_note: Side A's large blue-grey panel with readable gold costs fits the UI direction, but the Craft/Leave actions are small glyph-plus-text lines with no button treatment, and side B shrinks everything into clipped grey microtext.

Ic.bar_b_note: The cyan/navy water itself is on-palette, but the currents are dashed white road markings with chevrons painted on the surface, which reads as a debug overlay rather than moving water.

Lz.bar_b_note: Side A's timber frame, diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing finally read as a built wall, but it is still a thin freestanding card with flat cream infill; side B is a blown-out white sheet in a thin frame.

Fv.bar_b_note: The armoured Cannonback has good form, but the pale grey Ripplett nearly disappears into pale sand, a small blue object still sits half-buried behind it, and dense HUD boxes crowd the fight.

Nf.bar_b_note: The turquoise shallows and beach are on-brief, but the swimmer floats upright with both arms raised inside a small white foam ring, with no trailing wake, so it does not read as swimming.

Do.bar_b_note: Aquaryn stands upright on its legs on top of the water, with the same pose in all three frames and a big hard shadow on the surface but no wake or splash, so the mount looks pasted onto the water.

Fh.bar_b_note: Navy offshore now separates from cyan shallows, but the shelf bands are hard-edged and the islands are bare sand mounds with sparse props and no haze, nothing like the board's lush, layered archipelago.

Nk.bar_b_note: The tab state is now correct and the frame follows the UI direction, but the map itself is a blurred navy field with one yellow-green blob and orange lines, with no landmarks or island shapes to make it a world map.

Ms.bar_b_note: The Veilfall is now a pale, craggy spire rather than a dark cone, but it is a small bare rock with one thin fall, far from the board's towering green-terraced mountain with many white falls and mist.

top_changes.change: Rebuild Tidewake water dressing: replace the dashed-line current overlay with flowing foam and normal-map streaks, add wake, splash and ring effects for swimmer and mount, sink Aquaryn into the water with a stroke/bob cycle, and swap the hard surface shadows for soft contact shading.

Build the Veilfall hero landmark to the stronghold board: a tall tiered mountain with green terraces, several broad white falls and base mist, readable from across the archipelago; and dress the bare sand islands with vegetation and rock clusters.

Camera and staging pass: frame named dialogue as a close over-the-shoulder two-shot on the speaker, keep the dismounted Aquaryn visible but out of the way instead of a ghost outline, and remove the half-buried leftover figure from the Venn fight.
